# M18-S7 unit D, REDTEAM #194: eject lowers the four logos/arena calls
# to plain Go while keeping the evaluation order. A call whose region
# argument is a side-effecting index expression goes through the closure
# form, so the increment survives in the ejected program; a locally
# opened region loses its only use and needs the blank use after its
# declaration. A Go package of a second module keeps importing
# logos/arena, so the support module must vendor it.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

# logos runs the module before eject.
logos run .
stdout '^3 7 42 1 3 9 2$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

# Snapshot the source tree; eject must never write into it (#112).
mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cp go.mod $WORK/orig/go.mod
cp ../dep/go.mod $WORK/orig/dep-go.mod
cp ../dep/heap/heap.go $WORK/orig/heap.go

# Eject the main module.
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/_logos_deps/example.com/arenadep@v0.0.0/heap/heap.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/arena/arena.go

# The ejected main drops every arena call: no arena call survives, the
# opened region reads _logos_rt.Region{}, and the side-effecting region
# arguments evaluate inside the closure form.
! grep 'arena\.New\|arena\.Make\|arena\.Append\|arena\.Open' out/main.go
grep 'return new\(node\)' out/main.go
grep 'return make\(\[\]node' out/main.go
grep -count=1 '_ = r' out/main.go
grep '_logos_rt\.Region{}' out/main.go
grep -count=3 'func\(_ _logos_rt\.Region' out/main.go
grep -count=3 'regs\[bump\(\)\]' out/main.go
grep -count=1 '_logos_e1 \.\.\.node' out/main.go
grep -count=1 'append\(_logos_e0, _logos_e1\.\.\.\)' out/main.go

# The copied Go package keeps its logos/arena import remapped, and the
# support module serves it.
grep -count=1 'gosuda/loGos/rt/arena' out/_logos_deps/example.com/arenadep@v0.0.0/heap/heap.go
grep -count=1 'arena\.New' out/_logos_deps/example.com/arenadep@v0.0.0/heap/heap.go

# The ejected tree runs under plain go with identical output.
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

# The source tree is unchanged after the eject (#112).
cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cmp go.mod $WORK/orig/go.mod
cmp ../dep/go.mod $WORK/orig/dep-go.mod
cmp ../dep/heap/heap.go $WORK/orig/heap.go

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arenaeject

go 1.27

require example.com/arenadep v0.0.0

replace example.com/arenadep v0.0.0 => ../dep

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"

	"example.com/arenadep/heap"
)

type node struct {
	v int
}

var seq int

var regs [2]arena.Region

func bump() int {
	seq++
	return seq % 2
}

func locals() []node {
	r := arena.Open()
	s := arena.Append[node](r, nil, node{3})
	return s
}

func main() {
	nodes := arena.Make[node](regs[bump()], 3)
	nodes[1].v = 42
	p := arena.New[node](regs[bump()])
	p.v = 7
	s := locals()
	extra := []node{{5}}
	others := []node{{6}}
	u := arena.Append[node](regs[bump()], extra, others...)
	fmt.Println(seq, p.v, nodes[1].v, len(s), s[0].v, *heap.Node(), len(u))
}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/arenadep

go 1.27

-- dep/heap/heap.go --
package heap

import "logos/arena"

// Node allocates one int through logos/arena with a zero Region.
func Node() *int {
	r := arena.Region{}
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 9
	return p
}
